title: Love Bombing
summary: Love bombing is overwhelming someone with intense affection, gifts and attention very early, often to gain control quickly. It can be followed by criticism or withdrawal.
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
